{{Top}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:Nurchi-cardtrader.png]] |name=Nurchi |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[5 BBY]], [[Ferrix]]"[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]" dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', including Nurchi's [[death]] on [[Ferrix]] in "[[Rix Road]]," to [[5 BBY]]. |species=[[Human]]{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{Topps|set=2024 Topps Star Wars Chrome|cardname=Nurchi|link=https://www.ebay.com/itm/226292787735}} |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Dark |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Galactic Empire]]{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|I'm not one of these losers gonna let you float until they forget how much you owe them.|Nurchi to Cassian Andor|}} '''Nurchi''' was a [[human]] [[junk dealer]] and freelance [[Collector|picker]] that lived on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[5 BBY]], hoping to collect the money that [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] owed him, he enlisted the help of [[Vetch]] to intimidate Andor. However, his attempt was unsuccessful. During an [[Ferrix Riot|uprising]] on Ferrix, Nurchi told the [[Galactic Empire]] of Andor's arrival on the planet. While waiting in the [[Hotel Rix|hotel]] for the outcome, Nurchi was subsequently killed by a [[bomb]] thrown by [[Wilmon Paak]]. ==Biography== ===Encounter with Andor=== {{Quote|What, not happy to see me? What, no love for Nurchi?''"
"''No, I'm late, okay?''"
"''I know. I want my deposit back.|Nurchi and Cassian Andor|}} [[File:Andor_Season_One_Episode_1.png|thumb|left|250px|Nurchi confronts Andor and asks for credits]] Nurchi was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] freelance [[Collector|picker]]''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' who lived on [[Ferrix]], a [[planet]] in the [[Morlani system]], during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. While sitting on a chair{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}} in front of a [[Unidentified screen store|screen store]], Nurchi noticed [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] walking by and aggressively stopped him. While Andor insisted he had somewhere to be, Nurchi demanded he received his deposit for parts that Andor owed him.{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Star Wars|cardname=Vetch|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/370777/cid/22170406/2023-Topps-Star-Wars-76-Vetch}} To further force Andor to pay, Nurchi asked the [[Urodel]] [[Vetch]] to stand intimidatingly behind Andor, to which he asked Vetch questions before leaving him and Nurchi. Later that day, Nurchi sat on his chair and counted the [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] he received.{{Andor|That Would Be Me}} ===Imperial occupation and death=== {{Quote|You found him?''"
"''I want twice as much and a ride out of here when it's over.|Corv and Nurchi, on Cassian Andor|}} After [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] corporates caused a [[Ambush on Ferrix|ruckus]] on Ferrix while [[Hunt for Cassian Andor|hunting]] for Andor,{{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}} the [[Galactic Empire]] [[Takeover of the Preox-Morlana Corporate Sector|assumed power]] over the Morlani system, which included Ferrix.{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} Wanting to contact [[Luthen Rael]] about the [[Ferrix occupation|occupation]], [[Bix Caleen]] contacted him through the [[Repaak Salyard]], however Rael declined the call. The call was noticed by the Empire, and later went to the Salyard to detain [[Salman Paak]]. After hearing banging from Ferrixians, Caleen went to investigate the problem, only to find Nurchi and ask him what was going on. Nurchi was unaware of what was happening before leaving the premise.{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} [[File:Nurchi-rats-RR.png|thumb|right|300px|Nurchi tells Corv about Andor's whereabouts]] Later one night, [[Xanwan]] informed [[Brasso]] about a call he had with Andor. As the two walked, Nurchi eavesdropped on their conversation while talking to an individual. Xanwan and Nurchi later shared drinks together in a tavern{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}} and discussed the upcoming [[Maarva's funeral procession|funeral]] for [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva]], Andor's [[Parent|mother]], who had recently passed. During the day of Maarva's funeral, [[Pegla]], a companion of Andor, secretly hid him in one of the upper stories of a building. As Pegla exited the building, Nurchi noticed this and rushed to [[Corv]], an [[attendant]] to an [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[officer]], to inform him that Andor was hiding in the building. Nurchi demanded double the reward for finding him and a ride off Ferrix. As Corv asked where Andor was, Nurchi told Corv to pretend he was arresting him so they could talk in the [[Hotel Rix]], a [[hotel]] on Ferrix taken over by the Empire. As Nurchi awaited payment in the hotel while Corv and other Empire personnel checked the building, Maarva's funeral transpired, which eventually led to a [[Ferrix Riot|riot]]. As Nurchi watched the riot from the hotel windows, [[Wilmon Paak]], who was saddened by his father's death,{{InsiderCite|217|Star Wars: Andor Season One Companion|''Star Wars: Andor'' Season One Companion}} tossed a [[pipe bomb]] across [[Rix Road]], which led to an explosion that blew Nurchi away from the window, [[Death|killing]] him. As Andor rescued Caleen from Imperial custody, he noticed the body of Nurchi laying on the ground. ==Behind the scenes== Nurchi was portrayed by [[Raymond Anum]] in the television show ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the debut episode, "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," which aired on [[September 21]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}} Nurchi was revealed prior to the release of the episode in the official promotional assets linked to the show released by [[The Walt Disney Company|Walt Disney Studios]] via [[Wikipedia:Getty Images|Getty Images]] on [[August 19]], 2022.{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess#!asset/bgmfkwr42xhtqs4fpxw86v7r|text=The Walt Disney Studios All Access - PGM-FF-000276|date=2022-08-19}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|That Would Be Me}} *{{Andor|Announcement}} {{Mo}} *{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} *{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/andor/andor-season-1-episode-12-episode-guide|text="Rix Road" Episode Guide | Andor}} *{{SWCT|set=Andor Box|cardname=Nurchi}} *{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Star Wars|cardname=Vetch|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/370777/cid/22170406/2023-Topps-Star-Wars-76-Vetch}} *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' *{{Topps|set=2024 Topps Star Wars Chrome|cardname=Nurchi|link=https://www.ebay.com/itm/226292787735}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Nurchi |es=Nurchi |fr=Nurchi |ja=ナーチ |ka=ნურჩი |nl=Nurchi |pl=Nurchi }} [[Category:Ferrixians]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Information brokers]] [[Category:Males]]
